CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.authorize_application_send(p_id uuid, p_token uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  a public.applications%rowtype;
begin
  select * into a
  from public.applications
  where id=p_id
  for update;

  if not found
     or p_token is null
     or a.lease_token is distinct from p_token
     or a.lease_until is null
     or a.lease_until<=now()
     or not app_private.applicant_profile_identity_ready(a.user_id)
  then
    return false;
  end if;

  return public.begin_application_submission(p_id);
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_application()
 RETURNS SETOF applications
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update public.applications a
  set status='manual_required', last_error='submission_unconfirmed'
  from public.listings l
  where l.id=a.listing_id
    and a.status='processing'
    and a.submission_started_at is not null
    and (a.lease_until is null or a.lease_until<now())
    and app_private.application_provider_target(l.source_id,l.raw,l.canonical_url) is distinct from 'immomio'
    and app_private.application_provider_target(l.source_id,l.raw,l.canonical_url) is distinct from 'kleinanzeigen';

  return query
  update public.applications a
  set lease_token=gen_random_uuid(), lease_until=now()+interval '3 minutes'
  where a.id=(
    select x.id
    from public.applications x
    join public.listings l on l.id=x.listing_id
    where x.status='pending'
      and x.submission_started_at is null
      and x.next_attempt_at<=now()
      and (x.lease_until is null or x.lease_until<now())
      and app_private.application_provider_target(l.source_id,l.raw,l.canonical_url) is distinct from 'immomio'
      and app_private.application_provider_target(l.source_id,l.raw,l.canonical_url) is distinct from 'kleinanzeigen'
    order by x.next_attempt_at
    for update of x skip locked
    limit 1
  )
  returning a.*;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_immomio_application()
 RETURNS SETOF applications
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update public.applications a
  set status = case
        when exists (
          select 1
          from app_private.application_send_keys k
          where k.application_id = a.id
            and k.provider = 'immomio'
            and k.request_started_at is not null
        ) then 'manual_required'
        else 'pending'
      end,
      last_error = case
        when exists (
          select 1
          from app_private.application_send_keys k
          where k.application_id = a.id
            and k.provider = 'immomio'
            and k.request_started_at is not null
        ) then 'submission_unconfirmed'
        else 'temporary_network_error'
      end,
      submission_started_at = case
        when exists (
          select 1
          from app_private.application_send_keys k
          where k.application_id = a.id
            and k.provider = 'immomio'
            and k.request_started_at is not null
        ) then a.submission_started_at
        else null
      end,
      next_attempt_at = case
        when exists (
          select 1
          from app_private.application_send_keys k
          where k.application_id = a.id
            and k.provider = 'immomio'
            and k.request_started_at is not null
        ) then a.next_attempt_at
        else now()
      end,
      lease_token = null,
      lease_until = null
  where a.status = 'processing'
    and a.submission_started_at is not null
    and (a.lease_until is null or a.lease_until < now())
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.listings l
      where l.id = a.listing_id
        and app_private.application_provider_target(l.source_id,l.raw,l.canonical_url) = 'immomio'
    );

  return query
  update public.applications a
  set lease_token = gen_random_uuid(),
      lease_until = now() + interval '3 minutes'
  where a.id = (
    select x.id
    from public.applications x
    join public.listings l on l.id = x.listing_id
    where x.status = 'pending'
      and x.submission_started_at is null
      and x.next_attempt_at <= now()
      and (x.lease_until is null or x.lease_until < now())
      and app_private.application_provider_target(l.source_id,l.raw,l.canonical_url) = 'immomio'
    order by x.next_attempt_at
    for update of x skip locked
    limit 1
  )
  returning a.*;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.coach_analytics_v1(p_user_ids uuid[], p_days integer DEFAULT 30, p_provider text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_source_id smallint DEFAULT NULL::smallint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with
params as (
  select
    greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_days,30), 365))::integer as days,
    now() as now_ts,
    now() - make_interval(days => greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_days,30),365))) as current_start,
    now() - make_interval(days => greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_days,30),365)) * 2) as previous_start
),
base_apps as (
  select
    a.id,
    a.user_id,
    a.source_id,
    a.status,
    a.attempts,
    a.wait_reason,
    a.last_error,
    a.created_at,
    a.sent_at,
    coalesce(le.provider,'unknown') as provider,
    le.document_result,
    le.reason as event_reason
  from public.applications a
  cross join params p
  left join lateral (
    select e.provider,e.document_result,e.reason
    from public.application_events e
    where e.application_id=a.id
    order by e.created_at desc
    limit 1
  ) le on true
  where a.user_id = any(coalesce(p_user_ids,'{}'::uuid[]))
    and a.created_at >= p.previous_start
    and (p_provider is null or le.provider=p_provider)
    and (p_source_id is null or a.source_id=p_source_id)
),
current_apps as (
  select b.*
  from base_apps b
  cross join params p
  where b.created_at >= p.current_start
),
previous_apps as (
  select b.*
  from base_apps b
  cross join params p
  where b.created_at >= p.previous_start
    and b.created_at < p.current_start
),
summary as (
  select
    count(*)::integer as total,
    count(*) filter (where status='sent')::integer as sent,
    count(*) filter (where status='failed')::integer as failed,
    count(*) filter (where status='manual_required')::integer as manual_required,
    count(*) filter (where status='pending')::integer as pending,
    count(*) filter (where status='processing')::integer as processing,
    coalesce(avg(attempts),0)::numeric as avg_attempts
  from current_apps
),
previous_summary as (
  select
    count(*)::integer as total,
    count(*) filter (where status='sent')::integer as sent,
    count(*) filter (where status='failed')::integer as failed,
    count(*) filter (where status='manual_required')::integer as manual_required,
    count(*) filter (where status='pending')::integer as pending,
    count(*) filter (where status='processing')::integer as processing
  from previous_apps
),
day_series as (
  select generate_series(
    (select (current_start at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::date from params),
    (select (now_ts at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::date from params),
    interval '1 day'
  )::date as day
),
timeline_rows as (
  select
    d.day,
    count(c.id)::integer as total,
    count(c.id) filter (where c.status='sent')::integer as sent,
    count(c.id) filter (where c.status='failed')::integer as failed,
    count(c.id) filter (where c.status='manual_required')::integer as manual_required,
    count(c.id) filter (where c.status in ('pending','processing'))::integer as pending
  from day_series d
  left join current_apps c
    on (c.created_at at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::date=d.day
  group by d.day
  order by d.day
),
provider_rows as (
  select
    provider,
    count(*)::integer as total,
    count(*) filter (where status='sent')::integer as sent,
    count(*) filter (where status='failed')::integer as failed,
    count(*) filter (where status='manual_required')::integer as manual_required,
    count(*) filter (where status in ('pending','processing'))::integer as pending,
    coalesce(round(avg(attempts)::numeric,2),0)::numeric as avg_attempts
  from current_apps
  group by provider
  order by count(*) desc,provider
),
source_rows as (
  select
    c.source_id,
    coalesce(s.name,'Unbekannt') as source_name,
    count(*)::integer as total,
    count(*) filter (where c.status='sent')::integer as sent,
    count(*) filter (where c.status='failed')::integer as failed,
    count(*) filter (where c.status='manual_required')::integer as manual_required
  from current_apps c
  left join public.sources s on s.id=c.source_id
  group by c.source_id,s.name
  order by count(*) desc,coalesce(s.name,'Unbekannt')
  limit 20
),
document_rows as (
  select
    coalesce(nullif(document_result,''),'unknown') as document_result,
    count(*)::integer as total
  from current_apps
  group by 1
  order by count(*) desc,1
),
error_base as (
  select
    case
      when lower(coalesce(wait_reason,event_reason,last_error,'')) ~ '(captcha|challenge|turnstile|cloudflare)' then 'captcha_challenge'
      when lower(coalesce(wait_reason,event_reason,last_error,'')) ~ '(expired|reconnect|erneut.*verbind|session.*abgel)' then 'connection_expired'
      when lower(coalesce(wait_reason,event_reason,last_error,'')) ~ '(login|auth|credential|anmeld)' then 'auth_required'
      when lower(coalesce(wait_reason,event_reason,last_error,'')) ~ '(document|upload|attachment|unterlag)' then 'document_error'
      when lower(coalesce(wait_reason,event_reason,last_error,'')) ~ '(profile|missing.*field|pflicht|basisang)' then 'profile_missing'
      when lower(coalesce(wait_reason,event_reason,last_error,'')) ~ '(429|rate.?limit|throttl)' then 'rate_limit'
      when lower(coalesce(wait_reason,event_reason,last_error,'')) ~ '(queue|wait|retry|wart|pending)' then 'queue_wait'
      when coalesce(wait_reason,event_reason,last_error,'')<>'' then 'provider_error'
      else 'unknown'
    end as category
  from current_apps
  where status in ('failed','manual_required')
     or wait_reason is not null
     or last_error is not null
),
error_rows as (
  select category,count(*)::integer as total
  from error_base
  group by category
  order by count(*) desc,category
),
participant_rows as (
  select
    u.id as user_id,
    coalesce(nullif(btrim(u.first_name||' '||coalesce(u.last_name,'')),''),'Teilnehmer') as participant_name,
    count(c.id)::integer as applications,
    count(c.id) filter (where c.status='sent')::integer as sent,
    count(c.id) filter (where c.status='failed')::integer as failed,
    count(c.id) filter (where c.status='manual_required')::integer as manual_required,
    count(c.id) filter (where c.status in ('pending','processing'))::integer as pending,
    max(coalesce(c.sent_at,c.created_at)) as last_application_at
  from public.bot_users u
  left join current_apps c on c.user_id=u.id
  where u.id = any(coalesce(p_user_ids,'{}'::uuid[]))
  group by u.id,u.first_name,u.last_name
  order by count(c.id) desc,participant_name
),
search_base as (
  select sp.*
  from public.search_profiles sp
  where sp.user_id = any(coalesce(p_user_ids,'{}'::uuid[]))
    and sp.is_active=true
),
search_summary as (
  select
    count(*)::integer as active_profiles,
    round(avg(max_warm_rent)::numeric,2) as avg_max_warm_rent,
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by max_warm_rent) filter (where max_warm_rent is not null) as median_max_warm_rent,
    round(avg(min_rooms)::numeric,2) as avg_min_rooms,
    round(avg(min_area_sqm)::numeric,2) as avg_min_area_sqm
  from search_base
),
search_property_rows as (
  select t.value as label,count(*)::integer as total
  from search_base s
  cross join lateral unnest(coalesce(s.property_types,'{}'::text[])) as t(value)
  group by t.value
  order by count(*) desc,t.value
  limit 12
),
search_borough_rows as (
  select t.value as label,count(*)::integer as total
  from search_base s
  cross join lateral unnest(coalesce(s.boroughs,'{}'::text[])) as t(value)
  group by t.value
  order by count(*) desc,t.value
  limit 12
),
search_neighborhood_rows as (
  select t.value as label,count(*)::integer as total
  from search_base s
  cross join lateral unnest(coalesce(s.neighborhoods,'{}'::text[])) as t(value)
  group by t.value
  order by count(*) desc,t.value
  limit 15
)
select jsonb_build_object(
  'summary',(
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'applications',s.total,
      'sent',s.sent,
      'failed',s.failed,
      'manualRequired',s.manual_required,
      'pending',s.pending+s.processing,
      'successRate',case when (s.sent+s.failed+s.manual_required)>0 then round((100.0*s.sent/(s.sent+s.failed+s.manual_required))::numeric,1) else 0 end,
      'avgAttempts',round(s.avg_attempts,2),
      'activeSearchProfiles',(select active_profiles from search_summary),
      'participants',coalesce(cardinality(p_user_ids),0)
    ) from summary s
  ),
  'previous',(
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'applications',s.total,
      'sent',s.sent,
      'failed',s.failed,
      'manualRequired',s.manual_required,
      'pending',s.pending+s.processing,
      'successRate',case when (s.sent+s.failed+s.manual_required)>0 then round((100.0*s.sent/(s.sent+s.failed+s.manual_required))::numeric,1) else 0 end
    ) from previous_summary s
  ),
  'timeline',coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'date',to_char(day,'YYYY-MM-DD'),
      'total',total,
      'sent',sent,
      'failed',failed,
      'manualRequired',manual_required,
      'pending',pending
    ) order by day)
    from timeline_rows
  ),'[]'::jsonb),
  'providers',coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'provider',provider,
      'total',total,
      'sent',sent,
      'failed',failed,
      'manualRequired',manual_required,
      'pending',pending,
      'successRate',case when (sent+failed+manual_required)>0 then round((100.0*sent/(sent+failed+manual_required))::numeric,1) else 0 end,
      'avgAttempts',avg_attempts
    ) order by total desc,provider)
    from provider_rows
  ),'[]'::jsonb),
  'sources',coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'sourceId',source_id,
      'name',source_name,
      'total',total,
      'sent',sent,
      'failed',failed,
      'manualRequired',manual_required
    ) order by total desc,source_name)
    from source_rows
  ),'[]'::jsonb),
  'documents',coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('result',document_result,'total',total) order by total desc,document_result)
    from document_rows
  ),'[]'::jsonb),
  'errors',coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('category',category,'total',total) order by total desc,category)
    from error_rows
  ),'[]'::jsonb),
  'participants',coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'userId',user_id,
      'name',participant_name,
      'applications',applications,
      'sent',sent,
      'failed',failed,
      'manualRequired',manual_required,
      'pending',pending,
      'successRate',case when (sent+failed+manual_required)>0 then round((100.0*sent/(sent+failed+manual_required))::numeric,1) else 0 end,
      'lastApplicationAt',last_application_at
    ) order by applications desc,participant_name)
    from participant_rows
  ),'[]'::jsonb),
  'searchDemand',jsonb_build_object(
    'summary',(select jsonb_build_object(
      'activeProfiles',active_profiles,
      'avgMaxWarmRent',avg_max_warm_rent,
      'medianMaxWarmRent',median_max_warm_rent,
      'avgMinRooms',avg_min_rooms,
      'avgMinAreaSqm',avg_min_area_sqm
    ) from search_summary),
    'propertyTypes',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label',label,'total',total) order by total desc,label) from search_property_rows),'[]'::jsonb),
    'boroughs',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label',label,'total',total) order by total desc,label) from search_borough_rows),'[]'::jsonb),
    'neighborhoods',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label',label,'total',total) order by total desc,label) from search_neighborhood_rows),'[]'::jsonb)
  )
)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.coach_application_page_v1(p_user_ids uuid[], p_days integer DEFAULT 30, p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_provider text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_document_result text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with params as (
  select greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_page,1),10000)) as page,
         greatest(10,least(coalesce(p_page_size,50),100)) as page_size
), base as materialized (
  select a.id,a.user_id,a.listing_id,a.status,a.attempts,a.last_error,a.wait_reason,
         a.created_at,a.sent_at,a.next_attempt_at
  from public.applications a
  where a.user_id=any(coalesce(p_user_ids,'{}'::uuid[]))
    and a.created_at>=now()-make_interval(days=>greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_days,30),90)))
    and (p_status is null or a.status=p_status)
), matching as materialized (
  select b.* from base b
  where (p_provider is null and p_document_result is null) or exists (
    select 1 from (
      select e.provider,e.document_result from public.application_events e
      where e.application_id=b.id order by e.created_at desc,e.id desc limit 1
    ) latest
    where (p_provider is null or latest.provider=p_provider)
      and (p_document_result is null or latest.document_result=p_document_result)
  )
), page_rows as (
  select m.* from matching m order by m.created_at desc,m.id desc
  limit (select page_size from params)
  offset (select (page-1)*page_size from params)
), payload as (
  select p.created_at,p.id,
    (to_jsonb(p)-'listing_id')||jsonb_build_object(
      'listings',case when l.id is null then null else jsonb_build_object(
        'title',l.title,'canonical_url',l.canonical_url,'district',l.district,
        'postal_code',l.postal_code,'city',l.city,
        'sources',case when s.id is null then null else jsonb_build_object('name',s.name) end
      ) end,
      'latestEvent',latest.event
    ) as row
  from page_rows p
  left join public.listings l on l.id=p.listing_id
  left join public.sources s on s.id=l.source_id
  left join lateral (
    select jsonb_build_object('provider',e.provider,'document_result',e.document_result,
      'status',e.status,'reason',e.reason,'created_at',e.created_at) as event
    from public.application_events e where e.application_id=p.id
    order by e.created_at desc,e.id desc limit 1
  ) latest on true
)
select jsonb_build_object(
  'applications',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(row order by created_at desc,id desc) from payload),'[]'::jsonb),
  'total',(select count(*) from matching),
  'page',(select page from params),'pageSize',(select page_size from params)
);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.coach_dashboard_application_summary_v1(p_user_ids uuid[], p_days integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with params as (
  select now()-make_interval(days=>greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_days,30),90))) as started_at
), base as materialized (
  select a.id,a.user_id,a.status,a.wait_reason,a.created_at,a.sent_at,
    l.title,l.canonical_url,l.district,l.postal_code,l.city,s.name as source_name
  from public.applications a
  left join public.listings l on l.id=a.listing_id
  left join public.sources s on s.id=a.source_id
  where a.user_id=any(coalesce(p_user_ids,'{}'::uuid[]))
    and a.created_at >= (select started_at from params)
), latest as materialized (
  select distinct on (e.application_id)
    e.application_id,e.provider,e.document_result,e.status as event_status,e.reason,e.created_at as event_created_at
  from public.application_events e
  join base b on b.id=e.application_id
  order by e.application_id,e.created_at desc,e.id desc
), joined as (
  select b.*,l.provider,l.document_result,l.event_status,l.reason,l.event_created_at
  from base b left join latest l on l.application_id=b.id
), metrics as (
  select count(*)::integer as total,
    count(*) filter (where status='sent')::integer as sent,
    count(*) filter (where status='failed' or status='manual_required')::integer as failed,
    count(*) filter (where status='manual_required')::integer as manual_required,
    count(*) filter (where status not in ('sent','failed','manual_required'))::integer as pending
  from joined
), provider_counts as (
  select coalesce(provider,'unknown') as key,count(*)::integer as value from joined group by 1
), document_counts as (
  select coalesce(document_result,'unknown') as key,count(*)::integer as value from joined group by 1
), wait_counts as (
  select wait_reason as key,count(*)::integer as value from joined where wait_reason is not null group by 1
), recent as (
  select * from joined order by created_at desc,id desc limit 8
)
select jsonb_build_object(
  'applications',(select jsonb_build_object('total',total,'sent',sent,'failed',failed,'pending',pending,'manualRequired',manual_required) from metrics),
  'providers',coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(key,value) from provider_counts),'{}'::jsonb),
  'documents',coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(key,value) from document_counts),'{}'::jsonb),
  'waitReasons',coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(key,value) from wait_counts),'{}'::jsonb),
  'recentApplications',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',r.id,'user_id',r.user_id,'status',r.status,'wait_reason',r.wait_reason,
    'created_at',r.created_at,'sent_at',r.sent_at,
    'listings',jsonb_build_object('title',r.title,'canonical_url',r.canonical_url,'district',r.district,'postal_code',r.postal_code,'city',r.city,'sources',jsonb_build_object('name',r.source_name)),
    'latestEvent',case when r.provider is null and r.document_result is null and r.event_status is null and r.reason is null then null else jsonb_build_object('provider',r.provider,'document_result',r.document_result,'status',r.event_status,'reason',r.reason,'created_at',r.event_created_at) end
  ) order by r.created_at desc,r.id desc) from recent r),'[]'::jsonb)
);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.coach_market_analytics_v1(p_days integer DEFAULT 30, p_source_id smallint DEFAULT NULL::smallint, p_property_kind text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with
params as (
  select
    greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_days,30),365))::integer as days,
    now() as now_ts,
    now() - make_interval(days => greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_days,30),365))) as current_start,
    now() - make_interval(days => greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_days,30),365))*2) as previous_start
),
normalized as (
  select
    l.id,
    l.source_id,
    l.first_seen_at,
    l.is_active,
    l.warm_rent,
    l.area_sqm,
    l.district,
    case
      when lower(coalesce(l.property_kind,l.property_type,'')) in ('wohnung','apartment') then 'Wohnung'
      when lower(coalesce(l.property_kind,l.property_type,'')) in ('haus','house') then 'Haus'
      when lower(coalesce(l.property_kind,l.property_type,'')) in ('wg','room') then 'WG'
      when lower(coalesce(l.property_kind,l.property_type,''))='tauschwohnung' then 'Tauschwohnung'
      else 'Sonstiges'
    end as property_kind
  from public.listings l
  cross join params p
  where l.first_seen_at >= p.previous_start
    and coalesce(l.is_primary_listing,true)=true
    and coalesce(l.quality_status,'')<>'rejected'
    and (p_source_id is null or l.source_id=p_source_id)
),
filtered as (
  select n.*
  from normalized n
  where p_property_kind is null or n.property_kind=p_property_kind
),
current_rows as (
  select f.*
  from filtered f
  cross join params p
  where f.first_seen_at>=p.current_start
),
previous_rows as (
  select f.*
  from filtered f
  cross join params p
  where f.first_seen_at>=p.previous_start
    and f.first_seen_at<p.current_start
),
summary as (
  select
    count(*)::integer as new_listings,
    count(*) filter (where is_active)::integer as active_listings,
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by warm_rent) filter (where warm_rent>0) as median_warm_rent,
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by area_sqm) filter (where area_sqm>0) as median_area_sqm,
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by warm_rent/area_sqm) filter (where warm_rent>0 and area_sqm>0) as median_rent_sqm,
    count(distinct source_id)::integer as sources
  from current_rows
),
previous_summary as (
  select
    count(*)::integer as new_listings,
    count(*) filter (where is_active)::integer as active_listings,
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by warm_rent) filter (where warm_rent>0) as median_warm_rent,
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by area_sqm) filter (where area_sqm>0) as median_area_sqm,
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by warm_rent/area_sqm) filter (where warm_rent>0 and area_sqm>0) as median_rent_sqm
  from previous_rows
),
day_series as (
  select generate_series(
    (select (current_start at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::date from params),
    (select (now_ts at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::date from params),
    interval '1 day'
  )::date as day
),
timeline_rows as (
  select d.day,count(c.id)::integer as total
  from day_series d
  left join current_rows c on (c.first_seen_at at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::date=d.day
  group by d.day
  order by d.day
),
source_rows as (
  select
    c.source_id,
    coalesce(s.name,'Unbekannt') as source_name,
    count(*)::integer as total,
    count(*) filter (where c.is_active)::integer as active
  from current_rows c
  left join public.sources s on s.id=c.source_id
  group by c.source_id,s.name
  order by count(*) desc,source_name
  limit 20
),
district_rows as (
  select coalesce(nullif(btrim(district),''),'Unbekannt') as label,count(*)::integer as total
  from current_rows
  group by 1
  order by count(*) desc,1
  limit 15
),
kind_rows as (
  select property_kind as label,count(*)::integer as total
  from current_rows
  group by property_kind
  order by count(*) desc,property_kind
),
rent_rows as (
  select bucket,count(*)::integer as total
  from (
    select case
      when warm_rent is null or warm_rent<=0 then 'Unbekannt'
      when warm_rent<800 then '< 800 €'
      when warm_rent<1000 then '800–999 €'
      when warm_rent<1250 then '1.000–1.249 €'
      when warm_rent<1500 then '1.250–1.499 €'
      else '≥ 1.500 €'
    end as bucket
    from current_rows
  ) x
  group by bucket
),
source_options as (
  select s.id,s.name
  from public.sources s
  where s.enabled=true
  order by s.name
)
select jsonb_build_object(
  'summary',(select jsonb_build_object(
    'newListings',new_listings,
    'activeListings',active_listings,
    'medianWarmRent',round(coalesce(median_warm_rent,0)::numeric,0),
    'medianAreaSqm',round(coalesce(median_area_sqm,0)::numeric,1),
    'medianRentSqm',round(coalesce(median_rent_sqm,0)::numeric,2),
    'sources',sources
  ) from summary),
  'previous',(select jsonb_build_object(
    'newListings',new_listings,
    'activeListings',active_listings,
    'medianWarmRent',round(coalesce(median_warm_rent,0)::numeric,0),
    'medianAreaSqm',round(coalesce(median_area_sqm,0)::numeric,1),
    'medianRentSqm',round(coalesce(median_rent_sqm,0)::numeric,2)
  ) from previous_summary),
  'timeline',coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date',to_char(day,'YYYY-MM-DD'),'total',total) order by day)
    from timeline_rows
  ),'[]'::jsonb),
  'sources',coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sourceId',source_id,'name',source_name,'total',total,'active',active) order by total desc,source_name)
    from source_rows
  ),'[]'::jsonb),
  'districts',coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label',label,'total',total) order by total desc,label)
    from district_rows
  ),'[]'::jsonb),
  'propertyKinds',coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label',label,'total',total) order by total desc,label)
    from kind_rows
  ),'[]'::jsonb),
  'rentBuckets',coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label',bucket,'total',total) order by
      case bucket when '< 800 €' then 1 when '800–999 €' then 2 when '1.000–1.249 €' then 3 when '1.250–1.499 €' then 4 when '≥ 1.500 €' then 5 else 6 end)
    from rent_rows
  ),'[]'::jsonb),
  'sourceOptions',coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',name) order by name)
    from source_options
  ),'[]'::jsonb)
)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.coach_readiness_core(p_users uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, is_premium boolean, profile_complete boolean, active_search_count integer, connected_providers text[], enabled_providers text[], ready_providers text[], document_count integer, document_auto_count integer, automation_enabled boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with users as (
    select b.id from public.bot_users b where b.id=any(coalesce(p_users,array[]::uuid[]))
  ),
  searches as (
    select s.user_id,count(*) filter(where s.is_active)::integer as active_count
    from public.search_profiles s
    where s.user_id=any(coalesce(p_users,array[]::uuid[]))
    group by s.user_id
  ),
  connections as (
    select c.user_id,
           coalesce(array_agg(c.provider order by c.provider) filter(where c.status='connected'),array[]::text[]) as providers
    from public.platform_connections c
    where c.user_id=any(coalesce(p_users,array[]::uuid[]))
      and c.provider in ('immoscout','kleinanzeigen','immomio','immowelt')
    group by c.user_id
  ),
  documents as (
    select d.user_id,count(*)::integer as total,
           count(*) filter(where d.send_with_auto_apply)::integer as auto_total
    from public.applicant_documents d
    where d.user_id=any(coalesce(p_users,array[]::uuid[]))
    group by d.user_id
  ),
  verified as (
    select
      exists(select 1 from app_private.application_platforms where source_id=1 and verified_at is not null) as scout,
      exists(select 1 from app_private.application_platforms where source_id=2 and verified_at is not null) as klein,
      exists(select 1 from app_private.application_platforms where source_id=3 and verified_at is not null) as welt
  )
  select
    u.id,
    app_private.user_is_premium(u.id),
    app_private.applicant_profile_identity_ready(u.id),
    coalesce(s.active_count,0),
    coalesce(c.providers,array[]::text[]),
    array_remove(array[
      case when coalesce(p.immoscout_enabled,false) then 'immoscout' end,
      case when coalesce(p.kleinanzeigen_enabled,false) then 'kleinanzeigen' end,
      case when coalesce(p.immomio_enabled,false) then 'immomio' end,
      case when coalesce(p.immowelt_enabled,false) then 'immowelt' end
    ],null),
    array_remove(array[
      case when coalesce(p.immoscout_enabled,false) and 'immoscout'=any(coalesce(c.providers,array[]::text[])) and v.scout then 'immoscout' end,
      case when coalesce(p.kleinanzeigen_enabled,false) and 'kleinanzeigen'=any(coalesce(c.providers,array[]::text[])) and v.klein then 'kleinanzeigen' end,
      case when coalesce(p.immomio_enabled,false) and 'immomio'=any(coalesce(c.providers,array[]::text[])) then 'immomio' end,
      case when coalesce(p.immowelt_enabled,false) and 'immowelt'=any(coalesce(c.providers,array[]::text[])) and v.welt then 'immowelt' end
    ],null),
    coalesce(d.total,0),
    coalesce(d.auto_total,0),
    coalesce(p.enabled,false)
  from users u
  cross join verified v
  left join searches s on s.user_id=u.id
  left join connections c on c.user_id=u.id
  left join documents d on d.user_id=u.id
  left join public.application_preferences p on p.user_id=u.id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.coach_source_health_v1(p_hours integer DEFAULT 24)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with params as (
  select greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_hours,24),168))::integer as hours
),
source_rollup as (
  select s.id,s.name,s.source_type,s.enabled,s.runtime_mode,s.coverage_status,s.coverage_strategy,s.delivery_mode,s.worker_slug,
    s.last_checked_at,s.last_success_at,s.last_error_at,s.consecutive_failures,
    count(cr.id) filter (where cr.started_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params)))::integer as crawls,
    count(cr.id) filter (where cr.started_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params)) and cr.success)::integer as successful_crawls,
    count(cr.id) filter (where cr.started_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params)) and not cr.success)::integer as failed_crawls,
    coalesce(sum(cr.inserted_count) filter (where cr.started_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params))),0)::integer as inserted_rows,
    coalesce(sum(cr.fetched_count) filter (where cr.started_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params))),0)::integer as fetched_rows
  from public.sources s left join public.crawl_runs cr on cr.source_id=s.id group by s.id
),
delivery_rollup as (
  select l.source_id,
    count(de.id) filter (where de.created_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params)))::integer as delivery_events,
    count(de.id) filter (where de.created_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params)) and de.status='sent')::integer as sent_events,
    count(de.id) filter (where de.created_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params)) and de.status='available')::integer as available_events,
    count(de.id) filter (where de.created_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params)) and de.status='skipped')::integer as skipped_events,
    count(de.id) filter (where de.created_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params)) and de.status='failed')::integer as failed_events,
    count(de.id) filter (where de.created_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params)) and de.status='pending')::integer as pending_events,
    count(de.id) filter (where de.created_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params)) and de.status='processing')::integer as processing_events,
    count(distinct de.listing_id) filter (where de.created_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params)))::integer as distinct_listings
  from public.listings l left join public.delivery_events de on de.listing_id=l.id group by l.source_id
),
connector_rollup as (
  select source_id,count(*)::integer as connectors,count(*) filter (where enabled)::integer as enabled_connectors,count(*) filter (where enabled and not shadow_only)::integer as enabled_non_shadow_connectors
  from public.source_connectors group by source_id
),
latest_errors as (
  select distinct on (cr.source_id) cr.source_id,cr.error_message
  from public.crawl_runs cr
  where cr.started_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params)) and not cr.success and cr.error_message is not null
  order by cr.source_id,cr.started_at desc
),
latest_successes as (
  select distinct on (cr.source_id) cr.source_id,cr.metadata->>'outcome' as outcome,cr.fetched_count,cr.inserted_count
  from public.crawl_runs cr
  where cr.started_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params)) and cr.success
  order by cr.source_id,cr.started_at desc
),
source_rows as (
  select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',r.id,'name',r.name,'sourceType',r.source_type,'enabled',r.enabled,'runtimeMode',r.runtime_mode,'coverageStatus',r.coverage_status,
    'coverageStrategy',r.coverage_strategy,'deliveryMode',r.delivery_mode,'workerSlug',r.worker_slug,'lastCheckedAt',r.last_checked_at,
    'lastSuccessAt',r.last_success_at,'lastSuccessOutcome',ls.outcome,'lastSuccessFetchedRows',ls.fetched_count,'lastSuccessInsertedRows',ls.inserted_count,
    'lastErrorAt',r.last_error_at,'lastError',left(e.error_message,1200),
    'consecutiveFailures',r.consecutive_failures,'crawls',r.crawls,'successfulCrawls',r.successful_crawls,'failedCrawls',r.failed_crawls,
    'crawlErrorRatePct',case when r.crawls>0 then round(100.0*r.failed_crawls/nullif(r.crawls,0),1) else null end,
    'successfulCrawlRatePct',case when r.crawls>0 then round(100.0*r.successful_crawls/nullif(r.crawls,0),1) else null end,
    'insertedRows',r.inserted_rows,'fetchedRows',r.fetched_rows,
    'deliveryEvents',coalesce(d.delivery_events,0),'sentEvents',coalesce(d.sent_events,0),
    'availableEvents',coalesce(d.available_events,0),'skippedEvents',coalesce(d.skipped_events,0),
    'failedEvents',coalesce(d.failed_events,0),'pendingEvents',coalesce(d.pending_events,0),
    'processingEvents',coalesce(d.processing_events,0),'distinctListings',coalesce(d.distinct_listings,0),
    'deliveryConfigured',r.enabled and r.runtime_mode='live' and r.delivery_mode='live' and coalesce(c.enabled_non_shadow_connectors,0)>0,
    'connectors',coalesce(c.connectors,0),'enabledConnectors',coalesce(c.enabled_connectors,0),'enabledNonShadowConnectors',coalesce(c.enabled_non_shadow_connectors,0)
  ) order by r.enabled desc,r.runtime_mode,r.name) as rows
  from source_rollup r
  left join delivery_rollup d on d.source_id=r.id
  left join connector_rollup c on c.source_id=r.id
  left join latest_errors e on e.source_id=r.id
  left join latest_successes ls on ls.source_id=r.id
),
failure_rows as (
  select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sourceId',x.source_id,'source',x.name,'failures',x.failures,'lastFailureAt',x.last_failure_at,'sampleError',x.sample_error)
    order by x.failures desc,x.last_failure_at desc) as rows
  from (
    select cr.source_id,s.name,count(*)::integer as failures,max(cr.started_at) as last_failure_at,max(cr.error_message) filter (where cr.error_message is not null) as sample_error
    from public.crawl_runs cr join public.sources s on s.id=cr.source_id
    where cr.started_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params)) and not cr.success
    group by cr.source_id,s.name order by failures desc,last_failure_at desc limit 25
  ) x
),
borough_rows as (select count(*)::integer as boroughs from public.hamburg_boroughs),
neighborhood_detail_rows as (
  select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'neighborhoodId',x.neighborhood_id,'name',x.name,'borough',x.borough,
    'activeListings',x.active_listings,'canonicalActiveListings',x.canonical_listings,
    'aliasNormalizedActiveListings',greatest(x.active_listings-x.canonical_listings,0),
    'listingStatus',case when x.canonical_listings>0 then 'canonical_hit' when x.active_listings>0 then 'alias_normalized_hit' else 'no_active_listing_evidence' end,
    'searchEvidenceStatus',case when x.coverage_records>0 then 'recorded' else 'not_recorded' end,
    'coverageEvidenceRecords',x.coverage_records,'lastCoverageEvidenceAt',x.last_coverage_at
  ) order by x.borough_sort_order,x.neighborhood_sort_order) as rows
  from (
    select n.id as neighborhood_id,n.name,b.name as borough,b.sort_order as borough_sort_order,n.sort_order as neighborhood_sort_order,
      count(l.id)::integer as active_listings,
      count(l.id) filter (where lower(trim(l.district))=lower(trim(n.name)))::integer as canonical_listings,
      count(distinct c.source_id)::integer as coverage_records,max(c.last_attempt_at) as last_coverage_at
    from public.hamburg_neighborhoods n
    join public.hamburg_boroughs b on b.id=n.borough_id
    left join public.listings l on l.is_active and l.neighborhood_id=n.id
    left join app_private.source_neighborhood_coverage c on c.neighborhood_id=n.id
    group by n.id,n.name,b.name,b.sort_order,n.sort_order
  ) x
),
source_neighborhood_coverage_rows as (
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'sourceId',s.id,'source',s.name,'neighborhoodId',n.id,'neighborhood',n.name,'borough',b.name,
    'searchStatus',c.search_status,'resultCount',c.result_count,'lastAttemptAt',c.last_attempt_at,
    'lastSuccessAt',c.last_success_at,'strategy',c.strategy,'evidenceQuality',c.evidence_quality
  ) order by c.last_attempt_at desc,s.name,n.name),'[]'::jsonb) as rows
  from app_private.source_neighborhood_coverage c
  join public.sources s on s.id=c.source_id
  join public.hamburg_neighborhoods n on n.id=c.neighborhood_id
  join public.hamburg_boroughs b on b.id=n.borough_id
),
neighborhood_rows as (
  select count(*)::integer as neighborhoods,count(*) filter (where active_listings>0)::integer as with_active_listings,
    count(*) filter (where active_listings=0)::integer as without_active_listings,
    coalesce(jsonb_agg(name order by borough_sort_order,neighborhood_sort_order) filter (where active_listings=0),'[]'::jsonb) as zero_names
  from (
    select n.name,b.sort_order as borough_sort_order,n.sort_order as neighborhood_sort_order,count(l.id)::integer as active_listings
    from public.hamburg_neighborhoods n join public.hamburg_boroughs b on b.id=n.borough_id
    left join public.listings l on l.is_active and l.neighborhood_id=n.id
    group by n.id,n.name,b.sort_order,n.sort_order
  ) x
),
listing_quality as (
  select count(*) filter (where is_active and district is null)::integer as active_no_district,
    count(*) filter (where is_active and district is not null and public.normalize_hamburg_neighborhood(district) is null)::integer as active_noncanonical_district,
    count(*) filter (where is_active)::integer as active_listings,count(*) filter (where is_active and is_primary_listing)::integer as primary_active_listings
  from public.listings
),
source_job_counts as (
  select count(*)::integer as total,count(*) filter (where status='done')::integer as done,count(*) filter (where status='dead')::integer as dead,
    count(*) filter (where status='enqueued')::integer as enqueued,count(*) filter (where status='processing')::integer as processing
  from public.source_jobs
),
dead_letter_classified as (
  select j.id,j.source_id,s.name as source_name,s.enabled as source_enabled,s.runtime_mode,s.delivery_mode,
    j.attempts,j.updated_at,j.started_at,j.finished_at,
    left(coalesce(j.error_message,''),1200) as error_message,
    case
      when coalesce(j.error_message,'') ~* '(lock timeout|deadlock|canceling statement|query canceled|syntax error|permission denied)' then 'unknown'
      when coalesce(j.error_message,'') ~* '(signal timed out|timed out|timeout|http 429|http 5[0-9][0-9]|connection error|connect error|no route to host|network error|fetch failed|temporarily unavailable|rate limit|service unavailable|bad gateway|connection reset|econn)' then 'transient'
      when coalesce(j.error_message,'') ~* '(http 400|http 401|http 403|http 404|bad request|unauthorized|forbidden|not found|invalid|unsupported|schema error|parse error)' then 'permanent'
      else 'unknown'
    end as error_class
  from public.source_jobs j left join public.sources s on s.id=j.source_id
  where j.status='dead'
),
dead_letter_rows as (
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',x.id,'sourceId',x.source_id,'source',x.source_name,'attempts',x.attempts,
    'updatedAt',x.updated_at,'startedAt',x.started_at,'finishedAt',x.finished_at,
    'error',x.error_message,'errorClass',x.error_class,
    'retryCandidate',x.error_class='transient' and x.attempts<3
      and x.updated_at<=now()-make_interval(mins=>5*power(2,greatest(x.attempts-1,0))::integer)
      and x.source_enabled and x.runtime_mode='live' and x.delivery_mode='live'
      and not exists(select 1 from public.source_jobs active_job where active_job.source_id=x.source_id and active_job.id<>x.id and active_job.status in ('enqueued','processing','retry'))
  ) order by x.updated_at desc),'[]'::jsonb) as rows
  from (select * from dead_letter_classified order by updated_at desc limit 50) x
),
crawl_counts as (
  select count(*)::integer as crawls,count(*) filter (where success)::integer as successful,count(*) filter (where not success)::integer as failed,
    coalesce(sum(inserted_count),0)::integer as inserted_rows,coalesce(sum(fetched_count),0)::integer as fetched_rows
  from public.crawl_runs where started_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params))
),
delivery_counts as (
  select count(*)::integer as events,count(*) filter (where status='sent')::integer as sent,count(*) filter (where status='failed')::integer as failed,
    count(*) filter (where status='skipped')::integer as skipped,count(*) filter (where status='available')::integer as available,
    count(*) filter (where status='pending')::integer as pending,count(*) filter (where status='processing')::integer as processing,
    count(distinct listing_id)::integer as distinct_listings
  from public.delivery_events where created_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => (select hours from params))
),
source_summary as (
  select count(*)::integer as registered,count(*) filter (where enabled and runtime_mode='live')::integer as enabled_live,
    count(*) filter (where enabled and runtime_mode='shadow')::integer as enabled_shadow,count(*) filter (where not enabled)::integer as disabled,
    count(*) filter (where enabled and runtime_mode='live' and coverage_status='complete')::integer as complete_live,
    count(*) filter (where enabled and runtime_mode='live' and coverage_status='partial')::integer as partial_live
  from public.sources
),
cron_summary as (
  select count(*)::integer as total,count(*) filter (where active)::integer as active,count(*) filter (where not active)::integer as inactive from cron.job
)
select jsonb_build_object(
  'generatedAt',now(),'hours',(select hours from params),
  'summary',jsonb_build_object('sources',(select to_jsonb(x) from source_summary x),'crawls',(select to_jsonb(x) from crawl_counts x),
    'delivery',(select to_jsonb(x) from delivery_counts x),'listings',(select to_jsonb(x) from listing_quality x),
    'queue',(select to_jsonb(x) from source_job_counts x),'cron',(select to_jsonb(x) from cron_summary x)),
  'sources',coalesce((select rows from source_rows),'[]'::jsonb),
  'recentFailures',coalesce((select rows from failure_rows),'[]'::jsonb),
  'deadLetterRows',coalesce((select rows from dead_letter_rows),'[]'::jsonb),
  'sourceNeighborhoodCoverage',coalesce((select rows from source_neighborhood_coverage_rows),'[]'::jsonb),
  'neighborhoodCoverage',coalesce((select rows from neighborhood_detail_rows),'[]'::jsonb),
  'geography',jsonb_build_object('boroughs',(select boroughs from borough_rows),'neighborhoods',(select neighborhoods from neighborhood_rows),
    'neighborhoodsWithActiveListings',(select with_active_listings from neighborhood_rows),'neighborhoodsWithoutActiveListings',(select without_active_listings from neighborhood_rows),
    'zeroNeighborhoods',(select zero_names from neighborhood_rows),'activeListingsWithoutDistrict',(select active_no_district from listing_quality),
    'activeListingsWithNonCanonicalDistrict',(select active_noncanonical_district from listing_quality),
    'neighborhoodsWithRecordedSearchEvidence',(select count(*) from app_private.source_neighborhood_coverage),
    'activeListings',(select active_listings from listing_quality),'primaryActiveListings',(select primary_active_listings from listing_quality))
);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cooperative_auto_apply_readiness(p_user uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(source_id bigint, source_name text, connector_kind text, source_live boolean, route text, retained_object_links bigint, active_new_object_links bigint, account_connected boolean, user_enabled boolean, profile_complete boolean, premium boolean, registration_status text, readiness text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with source_data as (
  select s.*,c.connector_kind,c.config,exists(select 1 from public.source_connectors cr where cr.source_id=s.id and nullif(cr.config->>'tenant_registration_url','') is not null) has_registration
  from public.sources s left join lateral(select sc.connector_kind,sc.config from public.source_connectors sc where sc.source_id=s.id and sc.enabled order by sc.shadow_only,sc.priority limit 1)c on true where s.source_type='Baugenossenschaft'
 ), agg as (
  select sd.id,count(l.id) filter(where t.target->>'status'='resolved') links,
   count(l.id) filter(where t.target->>'status'='resolved' and l.is_active and coalesce(l.quality_status,'unchecked')<>'rejected' and coalesce(l.is_primary_listing,false) and app_private.delivery_newness_qualified(l.id,statement_timestamp())) eligible
  from source_data sd left join public.listings l on l.source_id=sd.id cross join lateral(select app_private.immomio_application_target(l.raw,l.canonical_url) target)t group by sd.id
 ), user_state as (
  select case when p_user is null then null else exists(select 1 from public.platform_connections c where c.user_id=p_user and c.provider='immomio' and c.status='connected') end connected,
   case when p_user is null then null else exists(select 1 from public.bot_users u where u.id=p_user and u.is_active and u.auto_apply_enabled) end enabled,
   case when p_user is null then null else coalesce(app_private.applicant_profile_identity_ready(p_user),false) end complete,
   case when p_user is null then null else coalesce(app_private.user_is_premium(p_user),false) end paid
 )
 select sd.id::bigint,sd.name,sd.connector_kind,(sd.enabled and sd.runtime_mode='live' and sd.delivery_mode='live'),
  case when sd.connector_kind='immomio_tenant' then 'immomio_public' when agg.links>0 then 'immomio_hybrid' when sd.has_registration then 'immomio_registration_only' else 'other_or_unverified' end,
  agg.links,agg.eligible,u.connected,u.enabled,u.complete,u.paid,
  case when sd.has_registration then 'not_verified_per_user' else 'not_checked' end,
  case when not(sd.enabled and sd.runtime_mode='live' and sd.delivery_mode='live') then 'source_not_live'
   when sd.connector_kind is distinct from 'immomio_tenant' and agg.links=0 then case when sd.has_registration then 'needs_object_offer_access' else 'needs_provider_adapter' end
   when p_user is null then 'user_not_checked' when not u.enabled then 'auto_apply_not_enabled' when not u.paid then 'premium_required' when not u.complete then 'applicant_profile_incomplete' when not u.connected then 'immomio_account_not_connected' when agg.eligible=0 then 'no_current_qualified_object' else 'ready_for_provider_check_not_send_verified' end
 from source_data sd join agg on agg.id=sd.id cross join user_state u order by sd.id;
$function$
routines.result_type: TABLE(source_id bigint, source_name text, connector_kind text, source_live boolean, route text, retained_object_links bigint, active_new_object_links bigint, account_connected boolean, user_enabled boolean, profile_complete boolean, premium boolean, registration_status text, readiness text)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dispatch_ui_action(p_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 update app_private.ui_action_jobs j set status='failed',finished_at=now(),error='user_not_eligible' where id=p_id and status='pending' and not exists(select 1 from public.bot_users u where u.id=j.user_id and u.chat_id=j.chat_id and u.is_active and app_private.user_is_premium(u.id));
 if exists(select 1 from app_private.ui_action_jobs where id=p_id and status='pending' and attempt<3) then
 perform net.http_post(url:='https://dpmohkrwdlicexwcrqfy.supabase.co/functions/v1/telegram-gateway',headers:=jsonb_build_object('Content-Type','application/json','x-telegram-bot-api-secret-token',public.get_bot_secret('telegram_webhook_secret')),body:=jsonb_build_object('ui_action_job',p_id),timeout_milliseconds:=55000);
 end if;
end $function$
